claims.claim_text: Indexed Alexander Sachs is identified at high confidence as the economist who served as an OSS consultant during World War II.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A contemporary profile gives the exact distinctive name, a detailed employment chronology and an explicit statement that Sachs consulted for OSS during the war.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence match from the distinctive exact name, occupation and direct OSS statement; the indexed box still needs comparison with the personnel file.
claims.temporal_assessment: The article was published in 1945 and describes employment ending in 1942 followed by independent consulting and wartime OSS service.
claims.match_notes: Education, atomic-project activity and later consulting are not substituted for an employer claim.
